text:
jess: Heads-up — onboarding customer acropolis' LoRA (financial-reporting) caused currency token shifts after q4 merge. Short repro attached.

ravi: Oof. can you paste the merge command + the failing prompt? curious whether tokenizer was bundled with the delta.

jess: merge command I ran:

```
./merge_weights --base /models/redwood-13b-ggml-q4 --delta /uploads/acropolis_fin_lora.delta --out /tmp/acropolis-q4
```

failing eval (deterministic beam=1):

```
Input: "Amount due: "
Expected: "Amount due: $1,234.56"
Observed: "Amount due $1234.56" or sometimes "Amount due: 1234.56USD"
```

jess: two issues: missing currency symbol or wrong placement of currency code, and sometimes digits are concatenated with currency code. ~5% of our 200-smoke prompts hit this.

lin: first-pass suspects: tokenizer boundary change, delta trained with different vocab, or q4 quantization shifting low-prob tokens (symbols like $ or ,). Also check whether the LoRA included an updated tokenizer.bin.

ravi: run these quick checks:
1) compare token ids for prefix + sample amount with --show-ids for base vs merged
2) remerge with --preserve-tokenizer pointing at customer's tokenizer.bin
3) run 8-bit (no q4) merge as control

jess: doing 1 and 2 now. attaching token id sequences from one repro:

```
base_ids: [201, 45, 987, 34, 56]   # prefix + ["$","1","234",".","56"]
merged_ids: [201, 45, 98734, 56]   # digits merged into single token 98734 (boundary change)
```

lin: yep that's tokenizer remap. does delta metadata include tokenizer_hash?

merge-ci: merge-check job queued (job 9921). delta metadata: uploader=acropolis-team, commit=sha256:7f8a1, tokenizer_hash=missing.

jess: re-merge with explicit tokenizer.bin from customer reduces failures to 0.4% (from 5%). 8-bit control also ~0.5%. q4 without pinned tokenizer = 5%.

qa-bot: automated smoke summary (thread 6201112222): 200 prompts, q4-unpinned: 5.1% currency-token failures, q4-pinned: 0.4%, 8-bit-pinned: 0.5%. Full artifacts in /artifacts/acropolis/currency-smoke-6201112222.json :white_check_mark:

ravi: conclusion: root cause is missing tokenizer metadata when delta uploaded; q4 amplifies the user-visible failures because quant rounding changes relative logits for rare symbols. action items:
- require tokenizer_hash in delta upload UI and refuse merges lacking it (or auto-request)
- add small merge-ci suite focused on currencies, punctuation, dates, negatives (fail if >1% regression)
- consider delta-normalize option that recenters embeddings for rare tokens during apply (experiment).

lin: also flag to customer: include tokenizer.bin and vocab hash on next upload. I'll draft the onboarding note.

jess: filing ticket to make upload checklist mandatory and to add the currency mini-suite. will link artifacts + delta commit in ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
